activities.title: Turn your plain text into a formal letter
activities.intro: Open your letter from 2.1. Tick each step as you finish it, then answer the questions.

items: Ctrl + A, then set Arial (or Calibri) 12 pt.
Office name: bold, 14 pt, centered. Section name: centered.
Select the three body paragraphs and Justify (Ctrl + J).
Ctrl + H: replace apps with applications (whole words only).
Run spell check (F7) and fix Collegues if you see it.

blocks.prompt: What font size is the office name now?
Which shortcut justifies the body paragraphs in Word?
Find and Replace: what word did you put in place of "apps"?
Spell check flagged a word in the greeting. Type it the correct way.
Why do we press Ctrl + S at the end, not Save As?
options: We are updating the same file
Ctrl + S makes a new copy
Save As does not keep the formatting

blocks.prompt: Optional: a screenshot of your formatted letter

help: Finished early? Make the signature name bold and add two blank lines above it for the signature.
Can't see "Find whole words only"? In Word's Ctrl + H box, click More.

activities.title: Quick check: fix a messy paste

blocks.prompt: You pasted a paragraph from an email into the letter. It came in a different font, size and colour. The fastest fix?
options: Undo, then paste with Keep Text Only
Change the whole letter to match the pasted font
Save the letter as PDF so nobody notices
